description: Machine-readable registry of protocol codes for the Agent Credential Layer diagnosis contract. Three namespaces are kept strictly separate: capability/state codes (positive observations), diagnosis/failure codes (negative causes), and resolution strategy codes (policy outcomes). Reauthentication is a policy result, never a per-code boolean.

reauthPolicy.note: reauthRequired is computed by the policy layer from the full diagnosis. Entries under reauthGuidance are advisory guidance only and never imply automatic reauthentication.

CONNECTOR_AVAILABLE.description: An already-authenticated platform connector is usable for this provider.

CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND.description: No candidate credential exists in any enabled source.

CREDENTIAL_INVALID.description: A candidate credential is present but rejected by the provider (for example 401 or 403).

CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.description: A configured credential source cannot be read (access control, connector offline, or missing file).

SANDBOX_KEYRING_UNAVAILABLE.description: The OS keyring or credential store is not accessible from this execution context.

ENV_NOT_PROPAGATED.description: An expected environment variable is absent from this process context.

NETWORK_BLOCKED.description: The provider endpoint is unreachable due to egress policy or blocking.

PROXY_MISCONFIGURED.description: Proxy settings are invalid or intercepting traffic.

TOOL_NOT_INSTALLED.description: A required CLI tool is missing.

TOOL_EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE.description: A CLI tool is present but cannot execute in this context (for example a denied subprocess).

WRONG_ACCOUNT.description: A valid credential authenticates a different account than the target.

WRONG_HOST.description: A valid credential belongs to a different host than the target.

WRONG_PROFILE.description: A credential matches the account but the wrong profile or selection is active.

TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT.description: The credential authenticates but lacks the required scope for the operation.

AUTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT.description: A validation probe exceeded its time budget; the result is inconclusive.

DIAGNOSIS_INCONCLUSIVE.description: Evidence is insufficient to classify the failure.

USE_CONNECTOR.description: Route the operation through an already-authenticated platform connector.

USE_EXISTING_CLI_AUTH.description: Use an accessible authenticated CLI or keyring path.

USE_PROCESS_SCOPED_ENV.description: Materialize a credential reference into the child-process environment for this operation only.

USE_PROTECTED_FILE.description: Use an explicitly configured protected local file source.

USE_EXTERNAL_BROKER.description: Resolve the credential from an external broker (future capability).

SELECT_ACCOUNT.description: Select the correct account credential or source.

SELECT_PROFILE.description: Switch to the correct profile selection.

CORRECT_HOST.description: Use the credential or configuration for the correct host.

INSTALL_TOOL.description: Install the required CLI tool or use a REST fallback.

RETRY_AUTH_CHECK.description: Retry the validation probe with a bounded time budget.

REFRESH_CREDENTIAL.description: Re-register or refresh the existing credential from a configured source.

REQUEST_ADDITIONAL_SCOPE.description: Obtain a credential with the required scopes rather than repeating the same login.

INTERACTIVE_AUTH.description: Interactive authentication as the final fallback, only after non-interactive recovery is exhausted and the user consents.

MANUAL_REVIEW.description: Escalate to a human with the sanitized evidence; take no automated action.

NO_ACTION.description: Fail closed; report evidence and take no action.
